content:
sophia: Heads up — received invoice VL-8721 from Velora, no PO number on header. Amount is $14,760 and billing period is 03/01-03/15. PDF: https://redwood-drive/finance/invoices/VL-8721.pdf

approvals-bot: Invoice ingested (inv_20240318_3176). Automated flags: missing_po, amount_variance. Default routing sent to chris_fin.

chris_fin: I don't own procurement routing. Can procurement confirm if there's an open PO to match? Also need GL to code if we hold.

procurement-bot: Searching... matched candidate PO 2240 for Velora (committed: $10,000). Variant: multiple invoices posted to same PO. Three-way match failed: invoice $14,760 vs PO $10,000. Tagging tanvi.

tanvi: Taking this. Looks like vendor billed for overtime / rush premium. We need ops sign-off and a signed change order for the extra $4,760. @jin_ops any approvals on your side?

jin_ops: No approval in our change log. We did request expedited on 03/08 but never approved the premium rate. Please HOLD payment. Jin to follow up with the engagement manager and provide timesheet evidence if vendor claims extra hours.

chris_fin: Placed AP hold: HOLD_PAYMENT_1961129900. Added note: "missing PO + billed over committed amount; await procurement/ops confirmation". Reduced payment queue priority.

billing-bot: Note added to invoice record: comment="Hold per finance; procurement to request corrected invoice or PO amendment; escalate if no vendor response in 48h." ticket_id=TK-5492

tanvi: We'll contact vendor AR asking for one of: (1) corrected invoice referencing PO 2240 for $10,000, (2) credit memo for $4,760, or (3) signed change order and line-item detail showing why extra charges applied. Will cc ops. Deadline 48 hours.

sophia: Drafting email now. Suggested text: 
"Please reissue invoice with PO #2240 OR submit credit memo for $4,760 OR attach a signed change order approving the extra charges, plus line-level timesheets. Invoice will remain on hold until resolved."

chris_fin: Thx. If vendor replies with partial dispute (claims different PO), escalate to vendor manager. Keep me in the loop for payment release. :white_check_mark:

tanvi: Will update thread after vendor reply. If no response within 48h escalate to vendor management and open dispute with procurement. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
